title: Collect and batch a vocabulary across documents
prompt: I want one vocabulary across a stream of documents. Add textkit.words.word_counts_many(texts) to total occurrences using word_counts rules and retain global first-seen word order, including for one-shot iterables. Then add textkit.sequences.word_batches(texts, size) to group those distinct words in that order using chunked size validation and final-partial-group behavior. Empty streams should give {} and [] respectively; invalid sizes must still raise ValueError.
parts: Aggregate document word counts in global first-seen order.
Batch the resulting distinct vocabulary with chunked size semantics.
